items.title: A constructible cohomology sheaf of a complex is hit by a finite sum of extensions by zero of the constant sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a finite sum of extension-by-zero sheaves mapping to a given complex and surjecting onto its constructible cohomology sheaf in degree b (statement lines 13610-13619). The proof (proof lines 13621-13641) uses the modules-on-sites representation of the kernel of the differential as a quotient of a direct sum of extension sheaves, and then cuts down to a finite sub-sum using constructibility of H^b(K). H2: one representation plus one finiteness step, written out.
